name: Content

semantics.id: canonical content identifier within a domain
semantics.type: how the resolved content resource is presented
semantics.provider: resolver namespace describing where or through which resolver the resource is obtained
semantics.content: inline payload or provider-relative resource identifier

providerRules: provider is not limited to external services
provider may resolve to an asset namespace or directory
embed providers such as youtube are handled by provider-specific resolvers
asset providers resolve relative resource identifiers; absolute filesystem paths and parent traversal are forbidden
rules: WebEngine owns the Content subsystem, storage contract, lookup and resolver lifecycle
Content does not own navigation items or navigation labels
Content does not own actions, buttons or action labels
Content does not own page layout, routing or domain behavior
type describes presentation semantics; provider describes source resolution
projectors reference canonical content identity instead of physical paths or provider-specific URLs
all content for one domain can be addressed as one namespace
